Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, Additional Chief
Standing Counsel for the State.
2. Petitioner applied for the post of
Anganwadi Karyakarti pursuant to an
advertisement issued on 30.12.2024. Petitioner's
application has been rejected on the ground that
she is not resident of the concerned revenue
village i.e. Suranshu.
3. Petitioner contends that even though the
revenue village of petitioner is different;
however, her revenue village is part of same
gram panchayat and the children from village
Khark, of which petitioner is a resident, are also
studying in Anganwadi Centre, Suranshu,
therefore, petitioner's application could not have
been rejected.
4. Learned State Counsel, however, has
taken the Court to the advertisement and also
the Government Order; the condition mentioned
in both documents is that one should be resident
of the concerned revenue village in which the
vacancy is existing. Since the vacancy is
existing in revenue village Suranshu, therefore,

2025:UHC:9218
residents of other villages even though very
close to village Suranshu cannot be treated as
eligible.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits
that the vacancy in question could not be filled
and the competent authority has now decided to
re-advertise the vacancy.
6. If that is so, the writ petition is disposed of
with liberty to petitioner to make representation
to the competent authority, to include the
residents of revenue village Khark in the zone
of consideration for appointment to the post in
question.
7. If petitioner makes such representation
within one week from today, decision thereupon
shall be taken within three weeks thereafter.
8. Pending application (s), if any, stand
disposed of.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
